This source group matters because Pokemon Card Trainers Vol. 4 turns the new Johto Darkness grammar into a magazine object: Murkrow supplies the creature, while Darkness Energy supplies the rules cost and power.

narrative.human_title: Pokemon Card Trainers Vol. 4 — Darkness arrives as magazine grammar
narrative.why_it_matters: This insert has a wonderfully specific hinge feeling. It is December 1999, the Johto world is still fresh, and Pokemon Card Trainers is not just reporting on the game; it is carrying the new vocabulary into binders. Murkrow gives the release a creature with night, omen, and Darkness-type identity. Darkness Energy gives it the rules object that makes the type playable and strange: extra power, a drawback, and not a basic Energy. The two together feel like a lesson slipped into a magazine. For agents, the important thing is not to flatten that lesson into a generic Neo Genesis memory. The magazine route, bonus-card border, and unnumbered promo context are the spine.

narrative.human_title: Murkrow — Johto's omen bird in the magazine margin
narrative.why_it_matters: Murkrow is a perfect little 1999 signal: a new Johto Pokemon, a Darkness type, and a Sugimori creature design arriving through a magazine insert instead of a pack. The card's own border gives the route away, naming Trainers Vol. 4 as the bonus-card context. That makes it useful to an agent in a very specific way: the name and art are not enough. The route, symbol, and border text are what keep this from becoming any Murkrow memory with a dark bird on it.

narrative.human_title: Darkness Energy — the new type becomes a cost
narrative.why_it_matters: Darkness Energy is easy to underestimate because it is not a creature. But it may be the more important half of the insert. It tells a player what the Johto dark world costs: power comes with a wound unless the Pokemon belongs to that darkness. Milky Isobe's art becomes part of a rules object that travels through Neo, e-Card, EX, and later eras, so the agent has to keep the magazine copy from dissolving into the general Darkness Energy lineage. This is exactly why the catalogue cares about assembly. The same rules memory can have many bodies.
